← THE DECLARATIONARTICLE I OF XXVII
GRIEVANCE I ◆ PUBLIC TRUST

He has made the powers of public office inseparable from the enrichment of his household.

THE RECORD SHOWS

The president and his family have continued to profit from cryptocurrency enterprises while his administration shapes the industry’s rules.

Reuters reported more than $1.4 billion in 2025 revenue to Trump from family-backed crypto projects, and described a forum at his private club bringing government officials together with financial executives and his family business. Ethics experts differ on the legal questions, but the overlapping financial and official interests are documented.

A DOCUMENTED SEQUENCE

3 MILESTONES
  1. 2025–26Family-linked cryptocurrency businesses operated while the executive branch reconsidered federal crypto regulation.
  2. February 2026Senate Democrats called for a national-security review of a reported $500 million UAE-linked investment in a Trump-family crypto venture.
  3. July 2026Trump financial disclosures and Reuters analysis documented large proceeds from cryptocurrency alongside conventional investments.

WHAT THE RECORD DOES NOT ESTABLISH

The UAE investment was reported and subject to demands for review; it is not presented as an adjudicated bribery finding. Business revenue and personal profit are not interchangeable accounting measures.
